source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: For every melee attack allocated to this model, roll one D6 once the attacking unit has made all its attacks, to a limit of six dice for each attacking unit; each 4+ inflicts 1 **mortal wound** on the attacking unit.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

ability.trigger: a melee attack is allocated to this model
ability.timing: after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks
